O time está sendo montado agora e os processos ainda estão sendo desenhados. Quem entra participa desse desenho e conversa direto com os times do Brasil e com os times globais. A operação brasileira está em expansão e a área de RH está ganhando escala, então quem chega agora acompanha esse crescimento de perto.

A empresa tem compromisso público com diversidade e inclusão. Este time está sendo formado com profissionais PCD desde as primeiras contratações, junto com a construção da área.

Candidate-se por aqui. O processo está avançando rápido.

description:
Analista Fiscal — Purim ContabilidadeSobre a Purim Contabilidade

A Purim Contabilidade é um escritório contábil localizado na Av. Dr. Gentil de Moura, 616, São Paulo – SP.

Atendemos empresas de diferentes segmentos, oferecendo serviços nas áreas Fiscal, Contábil e Departamento Pessoal , com foco em qualidade, conformidade e atendimento próximo aos clientes.

Descrição do cargo

Buscamos um(a) Analista Fiscal para integrar nossa equipe em regime presencial e período integral .

O profissional será responsável pelas rotinas fiscais de uma carteira de clientes, incluindo:

  • Escrituração, registro e análise de documentos e notas fiscais;
  • Apuração de impostos diretos e indiretos;
  • Elaboração e conferência de obrigações acessórias;
  • Fechamento fiscal e conferência das apurações;
  • Identificação e correção de inconsistências fiscais;
  • Acompanhamento e interpretação da legislação tributária;
  • Preparação de relatórios e informações fiscais;
  • Suporte aos clientes em questões relacionadas à área fiscal;
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças decorrentes da Reforma Tributária , incluindo seus impactos nas rotinas fiscais e nos clientes.
Qualificações
  • Experiência com rotinas de escrituração, apuração e fechamento fiscal ;
  • Conhecimento da legislação tributária e obrigações acessórias;
  • Conhecimento de tributos como ICMS, ICMS-ST, DIFAL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IPI e Simples Nacional , conforme aplicável;
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar inconsistências e interpretar normas fiscais;
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos prazos;
  • Interesse e disposição para acompanhar continuamente as mudanças da Reforma Tributária ;
  • Formação ou graduação em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou áreas correlatas ;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas fiscais e ferramentas de escritório.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior em escritório de contabilidade , atuando com empresas de diferentes regimes tributários;
  • Preferencialmente, conhecimento e experiência com o Sistema Domínio, da Thomson Reuters .

title: Revenue Accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.

You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.

What You Will Own

  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing
  • Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment
  • Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables
  • Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar
  • Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause
  • Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances
  • Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number
  • Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements
  • Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution
  • Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas
  • Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and RevOps on deal structuring and billing questions
  • Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle

What We're Looking For

  • 4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting
  • Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion
  • Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements
  • Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause
  • Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, or equivalent)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant
  • Availability for US time zone overlap

Preferred

  • SaaS, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics
  • Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or NetSuite ARM
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company
  • Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit

Why Join MAVI?

  • Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first
  • Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer
  • Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies
  • Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders
  • Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles
  • Flexible remote-first work culture
  • Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Estágio em Investimentos e Produtos de Previdência

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026

About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.

This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.

How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.

What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets

  • Design static ad systems for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization

  • Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself
  • Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.

You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems
  • Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it
  • Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area
  • You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team
  • A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves

  • Motion design or animation
  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. "It looked great" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.

What We Offer

  • Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually
  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product

How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

  1. Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  2. One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked.
  3. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

title: Analista de Licitações
description:
Estamos contratando Analista de Licitação

Presencial | Piedade, Jaboatão dos Guararapes/PE | CLT

R$ 4.000,00 a R$ 6.000,00, conforme a senioridade comprovada

Mais bonificação por êxito a cada contrato que a Argus vencer com o seu trabalho. Aqui a licitação ganha não vira só meta batida em relatório, vira dinheiro no seu bolso além do salário. A regra é aberta e explicada na entrevista, sem letra miúda.

Procuramos quem já opera licitação pública do lado do licitante, no detalhe, com o rigor de quem não pode errar habilitação, planilha ou prazo.

O trabalho é presencial e manual. Do primeiro item do edital até a homologação.

Essa pessoa também é a referência humana de um sistema de agentes de IA em construção: leitura de edital, cruzamento com a lei, impugnação, planilha, proposta, chat com pregoeiro, recurso e diligência. Se o sistema errar, é o analista quem aponta o erro e devolve o padrão certo. Não é vaga de engenheiro de software. É vaga de quem sabe o ofício e consegue ensinar a máquina.

Sobre a empresa

Prestadora de serviços contínuos em contratos públicos (limpeza, portaria, apoio, manutenção predial leve, motoristas e mão de obra terceirizada), com atuação em vários Estados. A base desta vaga é fixa em Piedade, sem necessidade de deslocamento.

Jornada e benefícios

• Bonificação por êxito a cada contrato ganho

• Segunda a quinta das 8h às 18h, sexta das 8h às 17h, com 1h de almoço

• Vale-transporte ou cartão combustível

• Vale-alimentação de R$ 30,00 por dia

• Plano de saúde com coparticipação

O que você vai fazer

• Prospectar e priorizar oportunidades nos setores da empresa

• Ler edital, TR, anexos e minuta do primeiro ao último item

• Cruzar com a Lei 14.133/2021, Lei 13.303/2016 (quando estatal), IN 05/2017 e Caderno de Logística

• Redigir e protocolar esclarecimento, impugnação e recurso

• Montar e conferir planilha IN 05 (módulos 1 a 6, encargos, insumos, tributo por dentro, FAP/RAT, VT, benefícios)

• Cadastrar proposta e operar a sessão nos portais

• Responder diligência, sanar habilitação e acompanhar adjudicação e homologação

• Manter certidões, atestados e credenciamento vivos

• Revisar a saída dos agentes de IA e documentar o raciocínio certo

Requisitos

• Lei 14.133 na prática (fases, habilitação, julgamento, recurso, diligência)

• Planilha de terceirização IN 05 de verdade

• Conta vinculada, repactuação e CCT da categoria

• Compras.gov / ComprasNet, PNCP, SICAF e pelo menos dois portais equivalentes

• Peça formal protocolável

• Excel avançado para conferir a planilha módulo a módulo

• Habilitação na vida real: atestado, índices, regularidade fiscal e trabalhista

Diferenciais

• Experiência em empresa prestadora de serviços contínuos

• Pregão de limpeza, portaria ou mão de obra até o lance

• Conlicitação ou radar equivalente

• Noção de Lucro Real vs Presumido no módulo tributário

• Já usa IA no trabalho (Claude, ChatGPT e afins), sem precisar programar

O que esta vaga não é

Não é home office. Não é estágio. Não é "acompanhar ComprasNet". Não entra quem inventa UASG, chute de custo indireto e lucro ou planilha que não fecha com o TR.

Para se candidatar

Use o botão de candidatura desta vaga. Na sua mensagem, responda em no máximo 15 linhas: anos na função, portais que opera, se já montou planilha IN 05, se já protocolou impugnação ou recurso, e um pregão concreto (órgão, objeto, resultado). Mantenha o currículo atualizado no seu perfil.

Reforçando: R$ 4.000,00 a R$ 6.000,00 conforme a senioridade comprovada, mais bonificação por êxito a cada contrato ganho.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Music
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Music Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in music will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse music-related topics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering music theory, genres, composers, artists, music history, production, instruments, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.

description:
Descrição de Cargo: Mecânico de manutenção de máquinas pesadas

Nível : Operacional / Técnico

Objetivo do Cargo:

Executar manutenções preventivas, corretivas e preditivas em frotas e equipamentos pesados de linha amarela e transporte (tratores, pás carregadeiras, retroescavadeiras, escavadeiras e caminhões).

Garantir a máxima disponibilidade operacional dos equipamentos no processo de movimentação, carregamento e armazenagem de fertilizantes, respeitando as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança do trabalho.

Principais Responsabilidades:

• Manutenção Preventiva e Corretiva: Diagnosticar, reparar e substituir componentes mecânicos, hidráulicos, pneumáticos e elétricos de máquinas de linha amarela e caminhões da planta.

• Operação de Sistemas Didáticos e Diagnóstico: Utilizar rastreadores e ferramentas de diagnóstico eletrônico para identificar falhas em motores a diesel, transmissões automáticas/powershift e sistemas hidráulicos de alta pressão.

• Preservação Contra Ambientes Agressivos: Executar inspeções e aplicação de tratamentos protetivos em chassis, articulações e conectores elétricos expostos ao pó e à corrosão severa de fertilizantes (como ureia, KCI e fosfatos).

• Testes e Liberação: Realizar testes de rodagem, aferição de pressão de sistemas hidráulicos e regulagens técnicas antes da liberação final do equipamento para a operação.

• Registro e Controle: Preencher ordens de serviço (OS) em sistema de gestão da manutenção (CMMS/SAP/TOTVS), detalhando causas, peças aplicadas e horas trabalhadas.

• Segurança e Organização: Cumprir rigorosamente procedimentos de LOTO (Bloqueio e Etiquetagem) durante manutenções, manter a oficina limpa e zelar pelo descarte correto de óleos e fluídos contaminados.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo + Curso Técnico em Mecânica, Electromecânica ou Manutenção de Automotores.

Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos atuando com manutenção de máquinas pesadas (linha amarela e caminhões).

Conhecimentos Técnicos: Leituras de esquemas hidráulicos e elétricos; manutenção de motores a diesel; sistemas de freio e transmissão. Certificações & CNH CNH categoria D ou E; Certificação para operação de máquinas (desejável NR-11 e NR-12).

Diferencial: Experiência anterior em indústrias químicas, de fertilizantes, mineração ou agronegócio.

Competências Comportamentais:

• Foco em Segurança: Rigor inegociável com normas de proteção individual e coletiva.

• Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade para investigação estruturada de causaraiz de falhas mecânicas.

• Proatividade e Agilidade: Resposta rápida a paradas não programadas para evitar gargalos na produção/embarque.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. This is not a traditional accounting role — you will carry the close for US clients and own real areas of their books in a fast-moving environment.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Accountant, you will run the day-to-day accounting for US clients, reporting to the client's Controller or finance lead.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will see the close from first accrual to final statement and own the parts that are usually spread across three people, with a US finance lead reviewing your work and available when a call needs to be made above your level. It suits someone who wants to carry a full set of books rather than process a queue within them, and who fixes a broken process rather than working around it each month.

What You Will Own

  • Carry end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients on a defined close calendar
  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, with accountability for cycle time and the quality of what you deliver
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed asset schedules, and month-end adjustments, with support attached
  • Prepare financial statements under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers you produced
  • Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and drive ageing items to resolution rather than reporting them
  • Maintain the supporting schedules behind the balances — prepaid amortisation, accrual detail, fixed asset registers, deferred revenue rollforwards
  • Handle and review AP, AR, payroll accounting, and cash reporting for accuracy and correct coding
  • Prepare variance analysis with root-cause commentary, in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Act as a day-to-day US client contact, building strong working relationships with their finance team
  • Prepare PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries in your areas through to resolution
  • Operate within the client's accounting policies and controls, and flag where a control is followed in form but not in substance
  • Maintain the close checklists and SOPs that keep the close reproducible without depending on any single individual
  • Propose process improvements and automation that shorten the close

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle end to end, rather than contribution to one part of it
  • Experience preparing full financial statements, including cash flow, for review
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the judgment to know when a balance does not look right
  • Experience supporting an audit, including PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Toast, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • CA / CPA / ACCA (or equivalent), or active progress toward one, preferred
  • Excellent English communication, with the ability to explain an accounting outcome to a non-accountant
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap

Why Join MAVI?

  • Carry a full close end to end for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Own real areas of a growing company's books rather than one corner of them
  • Gain exposure to audit, ERP work, and process design earlier than a comparable in-house role would offer
  • Clear progression to Accounting Team Lead, Accounting Manager, and Controller roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

title: Editor SEO (Slots)
description:
Vaga de Editor de Slots

Você assume o conteúdo de slots da Cardmates Brasil. Review de jogo, página de provedor, guia de mecânica, glossário, notícia de lançamento, ranking, tudo passa pela sua mão antes de ir ao ar. Quem lê tem que sentir que o texto foi escrito por alguém que já girou o jogo, não por alguém que traduziu a descrição do provedor.

No dia a dia

Você escreve e edita os textos da vertical de slots. Reviews dos jogos que o brasileiro mais roda, com sessão real, rodadas contadas, bônus ativado e o que o jogo entregou na prática, não o que o provedor promete. Páginas de provedor, da Pragmatic e da PG Soft até o estúdio que acabou de entrar no mercado. Guias de mecânica, Megaways, cluster pays, hold and win, compra de bônus, e o glossário pra quem está começando. Cobertura de lançamento, o ranking dos melhores caça-níqueis, comparativos, e o texto de apoio das lives de slots. Crash game, tipo Aviator e Mines, entra no mesmo pacote.

Boa parte do trabalho é revisar o material dos redatores. Você corrige RTP errado, volatilidade chutada, recurso copiado de outro jogo e aquela história de slot pagando e horário bom pra jogar, que não existe. Corta enrolação e devolve com feedback que a pessoa entende. Confere se o ganho máximo bate com a ficha do provedor, se a compra de bônus custa o que está escrito, se a faixa de aposta é a que aparece no jogo em real e não a da planilha em inglês. Leitor que joga percebe na hora quando o texto foi escrito por quem nunca abriu o jogo.

SEO faz parte do pacote. Você monta a pauta olhando intenção de busca, estrutura o texto pra ranquear e atualiza review antigo que perdeu posição. IA entra no fluxo pra ganhar velocidade, mas o texto final não pode ter cara de IA. Isso aqui a gente leva a sério.

O que você precisa

Conhecimento sólido de slots, de mecânica a matemática. Você sabe por que dois jogos com o mesmo RTP se comportam de um jeito completamente diferente e não precisa consultar nada pra explicar. Português afiado e texto limpo, com experiência real de edição e revisão. Noção prática de SEO, não só teoria de curso. Organização pra tocar pauta, prazo e vários textos andando ao mesmo tempo. E jogo de cintura pra dar feedback sem desmotivar o time.

Conta ponto

Experiência de jogador, de quem roda de vez em quando a quem conhece o catálogo de cor. Já ter escrito sobre slots, cassino ou iGaming. Inglês pra ler ficha de provedor e acompanhar lançamento antes de chegar aqui. Saber ler paytable e as regras dentro do jogo, e saber que o RTP que o cassino ativou nem sempre é o da ficha. Conhecer a cena brasileira, os jogos que estouraram, os clones que circulam por aí, os cassinos onde o brasileiro joga e o que a regulamentação deixa ou não deixa dizer.

Como funciona

Formato híbrido, PJ, em São Paulo, três dias no escritório e dois de home office.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer - History
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified History Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in history will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse historical topics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering ancient, medieval, modern, and contemporary history, civilizations, historical events, political history, military history, archaeology, historiography, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in History, Archaeology, Classics, Cultural Studies, Anthropology, Humanities, or other history-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of history, including familiarity with major historical periods, events, civilizations, political and social movements, notable figures, and cultural developments across one or more regions or periods.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in historical research, academia, education, journalism, publishing, museums, archives, historical content development, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to assess historical information, chronology, sources, and context accurately.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Head of Accounting
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.

We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.

The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.

You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

  • The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors.
  • Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.
  • Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

  • Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual.
  • Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.
  • External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

  • The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.

Team, Systems, and Standard

  • Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.
  • A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Rippling, or FloQast
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

  • Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat
  • Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI
  • Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Analista de Geoprocessamento
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Geoprocessamento para atuar com inteligência geográfica, análise e tratamento de dados geoespaciais, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas junto à Operação. Esse profissional será responsável por transformar dados geográficos em informações qualificadas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão Gerencial, garantir a atualização cadastral dos ativos da Regional, garantindo a confiabilidade das informações nos sistemas da companhia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coletar, tratar, analisar e validar dados geoespaciais provenientes de diferentes fontes, como GIS, imagens de satélite, GPS, drones, bases cartográficas e sistemas corporativos.
  • Atualizar, manter e controlar a qualidade das bases geográficas e dos cadastros técnicos, incluindo o sistema SIGNOS da Sabesp, garantindo a integridade, confiabilidade, consistência e disponibilidade das informações geoespaciais.
  • Elaborar mapas temáticos, mapas técnicos, dashboards geográficos, relatórios, gráficos e layouts cartográficos para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Executar análises espaciais para diagnóstico, identificação de padrões, modelagem territorial, modelagem de redes, definição e delimitação de áreas de atuação, bem como estudos de rotas.
  • Realizar georreferenciamento de imagens, pontos de interesse, redes e ativos de infraestrutura.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e plataformas de geoprocessamento, como ArcGIS, QGIS, AutoCAD Map e demais soluções geoespaciais.
  • Apoiar projetos de universalização, regularização cadastral, gestão patrimonial, planejamento de investimentos e iniciativas relacionadas ao saneamento, meio ambiente e desenvolvimento urbano.
  • Integrar informações geográficas com indicadores operacionais, comerciais, regulatórios, patrimoniais e de engenharia.
  • Apoiar equipes multidisciplinares na elaboração de estudos, projetos e soluções baseadas em inteligência geográfica.
  • Aplicar normas técnicas, ambientais e legais relacionadas ao uso e à gestão de dados geoespaciais.
  • Participar de iniciativas de transformação digital, automação de processos e governança de dados geográficos.
  • Apresentar análises, estudos, indicadores e resultados geoespaciais em reuniões técnicas e executivas, apoiando o acompanhamento de projetos e a tomada de decisão.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Cartográfica, Engenharia de Agrimensura, Geografia, Geoprocessamento, Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental, Tecnologia em Geoprocessamento ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas de Informações Geográficas (SIG/GIS).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de geoprocessamento, preferencialmente ArcGIS.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI integrado a dados geoespaciais.
  • Conhecimento em análise espacial, cartografia e georreferenciamento.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados geográficos e manipulação de dados espaciais.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Obrigatório Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) Categoria B.

Competências desejadas

  • Visão analítica e pensamento sistêmico, transformando dados geográficos em informações estratégicas para o negócio.
  • Proatividade, inovação e foco em melhoria contínua dos processos e da qualidade dos dados.
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a governança das informações.
  • Capacidade de relacionamento e trabalho colaborativo com equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com geodatabases, PostgreSQL/PostGIS ou SQL Server.
  • Experiência com automação utilizando Python para geoprocessamento.
  • Conhecimento em sensoriamento remoto, imagens de satélite e drones.
  • Experiência em projetos de cadastro técnico, gestão de ativos ou espacialização de ligações.
  • Certificações em ArcGIS, QGIS ou tecnologias GIS correlatas.

Informações adicionais

title: Senior Sell-out Sales Manager
description:
Haier Smart Home has arrived in Brazil and is looking for a Senior Sell-out Sales Manager to join its team.

Work Modality: On-site work, in São Paulo - SP.

Responsabilities:

  • Undertake and complete regional terminal sell-out sales targets, track daily/weekly/monthly retail sales data, analyze sales gaps, formulate targeted terminal sales improvement plans and implement them efficiently;
  • Optimize channel inventory management, monitor the inventory turnover status of distributors and retail terminals in real time, reasonably adjust product delivery and sales rhythm, reduce overstock and out-of-stock risks, and improve inventory capital turnover efficiency;
  • Guide and assist offline retail stores, distributors and sales teams to carry out terminal sales promotion, product display optimization, sales skill training and customer service upgrading, and improve terminal retail conversion rate and customer repurchase rate;
  • Analyze terminal sales data including product sales structure, hot-selling/slow-moving SKUs, regional sales differences and consumer preference characteristics, put forward product matching and sales strategy optimization suggestions, and drive sales structure upgrading;
  • Organize and implement terminal localized promotion activities, seasonal marketing campaigns and retail incentive policies, stimulate the sales enthusiasm of terminal sales staff and distributors, and boost short-term sell-out increment;
  • Track the terminal sales performance of competing brands, summarize their terminal promotion methods, pricing strategies and retail operation models, formulate differentiated terminal sales countermeasures, and enhance Haier’s terminal market competitiveness;
  • Establish a standardized terminal sales management system, sort out sell-out business process specifications, regularly conduct terminal sales audits and effect evaluations, and form closed-loop management of terminal sales business;
  • Cooperate with the marketing, supply chain and channel management teams to ensure the matching of terminal product supply, promotional resources and sales policies, and fully guarantee the completion of sell-out targets.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business Management, Retail Operation or related majors;
  • Experience in terminal sell-out operation and sales management experience in Brazil’s home appliance/retail industry, familiar with local offline retail terminal operation logic and sales management modes;
  • Experience in terminal sales breakthrough, inventory optimization and retail team activation, with outstanding data analysis capability and practical problem-solving ability for terminal sales scenarios;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, proficient in local business communication and terminal team management, able to independently launch terminal sales promotion projects;
  • Sensitive to sales data, able to quickly locate terminal sales pain points, formulate executable improvement plans, and focus on result-oriented target delivery;
  • Strong execution, on-site management ability and pressure resistance, good at team motivation and cross-team business collaboration;
  • Familiar with the retail market rules and consumer characteristics of Brazil’s home appliance industry.

We offer:

  • Meal Allowance
  • Mobility Allowance
  • Health and Dental Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Wellhub
  • Birthday day off

title: Analista de contas a receber
description:
OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Assegurar a gestão correta da carteira de contas a receber, desde a emissão e liquidação dos títulos até a conciliação, cobrança e controle da inadimplência, garantindo integridade das informações, cumprimento de prazos e suporte à tomada de decisão financeira.

DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES

1. Recebimentos e conciliação

  • Emitir boletos e processar arquivos bancários de remessa e retorno (CNAB);
  • Registrar, baixar e conciliar recebimentos por boleto, depósito, cartão e demais meios utilizados pela empresa;
  • Tratar divergências de liquidação e manter os saldos do contas a receber conciliados;

  • Monitorar a carteira vencida e apresentar a posição de saldos, aging e ações de cobrança;

3. Cadastro, controles e qualidade da informação

  • Analisar cadastros, restrições e referências comerciais, observando os critérios e alçadas vigentes;
  • Identificar e corrigir inconsistências cadastrais, financeiras ou de parametrização que afetem o contas a receber;
  • Manter controles e documentos do processo organizados e rastreáveis, apoiando auditorias e demandas da Controladoria.

REQUISITOS E COMPETÊNCIAS

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Gestão Financeira ou áreas correlatas;

title: Domain Expert- Politics
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Politics Domain Expert to evaluate and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You will design challenging prompts, assess factual accuracy and reasoning, and identify knowledge gaps within political science, governance, elections, public policy, international relations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create advanced prompts covering political science, governance, elections, public policy and international relations.
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and nuance.
  • Identify hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, outdated information, and edge cases.
  • Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases.
  • Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance.
  • Maintain high annotation quality and documentation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, Government, Public Administration, Law, Economics, Journalism, or other politics-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of politics, including political systems, governance, elections, public policy, international relations, political institutions, comparative politics, and current global political developments.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in public policy, government, political research, political consulting, academia, journalism, international affairs, think tanks, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate political information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a wide range of political and public policy topics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation.
  • Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: FP&A Manager - Remote (Work from anywhere)
description:
About the job

Own SaaS Financial Planning. Drive US Business Strategy. Lead from Brazil.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting and finance professionals directly into their teams. In Mexico, we focus on building long-term partnerships — where professionals operate as a true extension of US finance teams, not just offshore support.

This is not traditional outsourcing. You will work directly with US founders, Controllers, and finance leaders in lean, fast-moving environments.

The Opportunity

We are hiring an FP&A Manager to lead financial planning and analysis for US-based SaaS clients with structured corporate finance operations. You will own the full planning cycle — from budget build to monthly reporting — while acting as a strategic finance partner to US CFOs and business leaders.

This role is designed for an experienced FP&A professional who understands SaaS unit economics, recurring revenue models, and how finance drives decision-making in high-growth tech companies.

What You Will Own

  • Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting for US SaaS clients
  • Build and maintain financial models covering ARR, MRR, churn, and unit economics
  • Own monthly variance reporting with actionable business commentary for US leadership
  • Partner with US CFOs and senior leaders on strategic planning and scenario analysis
  • Develop KPI dashboards and financial performance frameworks
  • Analyze SaaS metrics including CAC, LTV, gross margin, and cohort retention
  • Support board-level reporting, investor presentations, and fundraising data
  • Drive improvements in financial planning processes and tooling

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of FP&A experience in SaaS or corporate finance environments
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, metrics, and recurring revenue dynamics
  • Experience working within or directly supporting corporate-structured SaaS companies
  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities
  • Proficiency with FP&A or BI tools (Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment, Tableau, or Excel)
  • Advanced English with strong executive communication skills
  • Ability to work consistently in US time zone overlap

Why Join MAVI?

  • Direct partnership with US CFOs and SaaS finance leadership teams
  • Own strategic FP&A for high-growth US tech businesses
  • Exposure to corporate-level finance in a fully remote setup
  • Competitive compensation and long-term client partnerships
  • Fast-track path into VP Finance and CFO-track roles

description:

A Instituição oferece toda a sua experiência a trabalhadores e empresários, com programações presenciais e a distância, de norte a sul do Brasil. São milhares de programações, em centenas de ambientes educacionais de ponta e especializados, como as empresas pedagógicas, que possibilitam o aprendizado prático, e as 87 unidades móveis que chegam a todos os estados e ao Distrito Federal.

Você acredita no poder da educação para transformar vidas? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Estamos em busca de profissionais comprometidos e apaixonados por fazer a diferença.

Se você é pessoa com deficiência e mora em Brasília , envie seu currículo para , junto com a cópia do seu laudo médico .

As oportunidades podem surgir em diversas áreas, como:

A equipe de Recrutamento e Seleção analisará os currículos recebidos e encaminhará para as vagas disponíveis, desde que os requisitos mínimos obrigatórios sejam atendidos.

Junte-se a nós e ajude a transformar vidas todos os dias!

description:

Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

Responsabilidades

Buscamos um profissional apaixonado por Inteligência Artificial, com forte capacidade de liderança técnica, capaz de atuar desde a sustentação e evolução das soluções de IA homologadas até a condução de novos casos de uso, agentes e workflows em ambiente corporativo.

Será responsável por liderar tecnicamente a equipe de Engenheiros de IA, apoiar clientes internos e áreas de negócio na adoção segura e responsável de IA, e atuar como ponto focal entre estratégia, governança e operação — combinando visão consultiva, profundidade técnica e forte capacidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente a sustentação, evolução e melhoria contínua dos sistemas, ferramentas, workflows, agentes e casos de uso de IA homologados no escritório (incluindo Harvey, Gemini, HighQ, My AI Drive, entre outros aprovados pelo CoE de IA);
  • Gerir tecnicamente os Engenheiros de IA Pleno e Sênior, orientando prioridades, acompanhando entregas, removendo impedimentos e promovendo padronização técnica;
  • Atuar como ponto focal operacional do CoE de IA na TI, conectando estratégia, governança, projetos, sustentação e indicadores das soluções de IA;
  • Garantir que tickets, incidentes, requisições e problemas de IA sejam tratados conforme os processos ITIL (registro, classificação, priorização, escalonamento e encerramento);
  • Definir, revisar e manter critérios de triagem, classificação e escalonamento das demandas de IA;
  • Consultar o Especialista de IA interno sempre que houver necessidade de validação técnica, arquitetural, de governança, riscos, segurança ou uso responsável;
  • Atuar de forma multidisciplinar com as áreas de Estratégia, Inovação, Dados, Segurança da Informação, Arquitetura, Infraestrutura e áreas de negócio;
  • Participar de projetos de avaliação, prova de conceito, homologação, implantação e transição para operação de novas ferramentas de IA;
  • Coordenar a documentação de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho, bases de conhecimento e lições aprendidas;
  • Manter dashboards e indicadores de adoção, uso, atendimento, SLAs, produtividade, ROI e satisfação dos usuários;
  • Orientar usuários, legal engineers e áreas de negócio na criação e melhoria de workflows, agentes, prompts e casos de uso de IA;
  • Garantir uso responsável e seguro de IA, em conformidade com LGPD, segurança da informação e diretrizes de governança;
  • Apoiar programas de capacitação, treinamentos técnicos e disseminação de boas práticas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em liderança técnica, sustentação de soluções tecnológicas, operação de serviços de TI e gestão de demandas;
  • Vivência com integração de aplicações, automação e projetos envolvendo IA generativa, preferencialmente em ambientes corporativos regulados ou intensivos em dados/documentos;
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de IA generativa: LLMs, SLMs, agentes, multiagentes, orquestração, engenharia de prompt, bancos de dados vetoriais, guardrails, RAG, APIs;
  • Conhecimento em governança de IA, IA responsável, LGPD, segurança da informação, privacidade, gestão de riscos e ITIL;
  • Capacidade de orientar tecnicamente profissionais Pleno e Sênior, priorizar backlog e atuar como ponto de escalonamento técnico;
  • Certificação obrigatória: ITIL Foundation ou HDI;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado (leitura técnica, interação com fornecedores e acompanhamento de tendências).

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação/especialização em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning, Ciência de Dados ou Arquitetura de Soluções;
  • Certificações em IA generativa, cloud, segurança da informação, privacidade, governança de IA, arquitetura de soluções, dados ou gestão ágil.

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Visão analítica e senso de prioridade;
  • Autonomia, colaboração e postura consultiva;
  • Disciplina documental e organização;
  • Foco em resultado e capacidade de traduzir demandas de negócio em direcionamentos técnicos executáveis;
  • Orientação a serviços

Modelo de Atuação: Híbrido, sendo 2X vezes por semana no Itaim Bibi.

title: Business Partner SR - DHO
description:
Pionerismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.

Muito além de uma divulgação de vaga, este é um convite para você fazer parte de uma história pioneira, que une inovação, responsabilidade socioambiental e relevância estratégica no cenário global da mineração de terras raras.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal. Somos corajosos e empreendedores.

As inscrições também estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), mulheres e grupos prioritários, em conformidade com os princípios de inclusão e equidade.

  • Data-driven decision making.
  • Resilience and adaptability in dynamic environments.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Science & Technology
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Science & Technology Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in science and technology will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of scientific and technological topics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, and related fields.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, technical correctness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or technically complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or other science and technology-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of science and technology, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering principles, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, scientific research, and recent technological advancements.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in scientific research, engineering, technology, software development, academia, technical writing, science journalism, data science, AI, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Sports
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Sports Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in sports will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a wide range of sporting disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering global sports, leagues, athletes, tournaments, rules, statistics, sports history, analytics, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in Sports Management, Sports Science, Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, or other sports-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of sports, including familiarity with major leagues, teams, athletes, tournaments, rules, statistics, and key developments across one or more sports.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in sports journalism, sports media, sports content, research, analysis, reporting, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to assess sports-related information accurately.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Júnior | CRM
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória com mais de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1400 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 70 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de CRM é responsável por transformar dados de clientes em informações estratégicas para apoiar decisões de negócio. Atua na análise do comportamento da base de clientes, identificação de oportunidades de crescimento, retenção e relacionamento, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de ações mais assertivas e orientadas por dados. A área trabalha em parceria com diferentes times, apoiando iniciativas que fortalecem os resultados do negócio e a experiência dos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Analisar o perfil e o comportamento da base de clientes, identificando padrões, tendências, oportunidades e riscos para o negócio.
  • Traduzir demandas das áreas parceiras em problemas analíticos estruturados, apoiando a definição das melhores abordagens de análise.
  • Construir, atualizar e interpretar análises, relatórios e dashboards para acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho.
  • Monitorar KPIs, garantindo a consistência e a qualidade das informações utilizadas nas análises.
  • Gerar insights acionáveis e recomendações que contribuam para a tomada de decisão das áreas de negócio.
  • Atuar em parceria com diferentes áreas, buscando compreender contextos e necessidades para apoiar decisões orientadas por dados.
  • Apoiar a priorização e organização das demandas analíticas, considerando impacto e urgência.
  • Participar de projetos multidisciplinares, contribuindo com análises e visão de negócio.
  • Consolidar resultados e comunicar conclusões de forma clara, objetiva e adequada aos diferentes públicos.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimento básico em SQL para consultas, extração e manipulação de dados.
  • Excel intermediário ou avançado para análise e tratamento de informações.
  • Capacidade analítica e raciocínio estruturado para resolução de problemas de negócio.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e transformá-los em informações relevantes.
  • Boa comunicação para apresentar análises e recomendações de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com capacidade de priorização.
  • Interesse por dados, comportamento do cliente e indicadores de negócio.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Experiência prévia, acadêmica ou profissional, em áreas analíticas, inteligência de mercado ou consultoria de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados e construção de dashboards.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de relacionamento, retenção e comportamento de clientes.
  • Vivência em projetos multidisciplinares com diferentes áreas de negócio.
  • Capacidade de identificar oportunidades e propor recomendações com base em análises de dados.
  • Interesse em desenvolver conhecimentos em Analytics, Estratégia e CRM.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: ADVOGADA - CONTROLLER JURÍDICO - CONTROLADORIA JURÍDICA- PRESENCIAL
description:
